The nginx deployment in the default namespace is failing to pull its image again on a new pod nginx-7f8d9b6c5-x4k2m. Events:
Warning  Failed     1m ago  kubelet  Failed to pull image "nginx123:def": rpc error: code = NotFound desc = failed to pull and unpack image: manifest unknown
Warning  Failed     1m ago  kubelet  Error: ErrImagePull
Warning  Failed     30s ago kubelet  Error: ImagePullBackOff

Check your memory of past Kubernetes incidents for this nginx workload: what exact pod name and invalid image tag caused this issue previously, and what exact kubectl remediation command was used to fix it?
